fixture.text:
Week 1 — starting point for the next three weeks.
Add a rep where the range allows; add a little weight only when all reps stay clean.
If sleep or work gets rough, repeat the previous load. No need to make up missed sets.
Warm up with a few easy sets on the first lift. They do not count toward the work below.
After the first lift, use the listed rest as a guide and take longer if your breathing has not settled.
Week 2: one extra set on most lifts at the same weights; deadlift goes a bit heavier for fewer reps.
Week 3: keep the added load on the main lifts, then stop each set with the same form you used in week one.
Message me the top set and any joint discomfort; soreness is fine, sharp pain is a stop signal.

Use the same seat setting next time so we can compare reps fairly.

leg curl 3x10-12

ab roller 3×6-8 @RIR2


Breathe out as the wheel moves away; stop before your lower back dips.
tricep pushdown 3 x 10-12 RIR 1-2
